Goal: Extract app positioning before writing store copy
Prompt Template: I will provide an app idea, feature list, or codebase summary. Act as an ASO specialist and identify the USP, primary persona, core problem, keyword clusters, best-fit category, and tags.
Output Schema: { usp, persona, short_tail_keywords, long_tail_keywords, category, tags, differentiation }
Required Inputs: feature summary, target user, monetization model, platform scope
Length/Limit: No invented claims; infer only from provided facts
Quality Gate: Use plain language and avoid keyword stuffing
Notes: Start with facts, then infer positioning

Prompt Template: Generate an app name that combines the brand with one core keyword. Keep it readable and policy-safe.
Quality Gate: Avoid 'best', '#1', and misleading claims
Notes: Prefer natural phrasing over forced keyword matches

Prompt Template: Write a short description that states the main value and ends with a soft CTA.
Quality Gate: One sentence only; no spammy repetition
Notes: Focus on the strongest benefit

Prompt Template: Write a full description with sections for intro, key features, benefits, how it works, trust, and privacy.
Output Schema: { intro, features, benefits, how_it_works, trust, privacy }
Quality Gate: Must be truthful, readable, and scannable
Notes: Use bullet lists and short paragraphs

Prompt Template: List short-tail and long-tail keywords with priority levels and intent notes.
Required Inputs: industry, user pain points, competitor context
Length/Limit: No volume claims unless provided by data
Quality Gate: Prefer relevance over density
Notes: Group by intent and feature

Prompt Template: Map the app features to the likely content rating answers and flag any uncertain items that need human confirmation.
Output Schema: { violence, language, user_control, location, social_features, gambling }
Required Inputs: app interactions, social features, location use, user-generated content
Length/Limit: Do not guess when the feature is unknown
Quality Gate: Truthful answers only
Notes: Escalate any unclear sensitive content

Prompt Template: List the data types the app actually collects or shares, how they are used, and whether they are encrypted in transit and deletable.
Output Schema: { personal_info, location, device_id, app_activity, photos_videos, files_docs, encryption, deletion_request }
Required Inputs: actual data collection flows, analytics, auth, ads, location usage
Length/Limit: Only declare data that exists in the product
Quality Gate: No generic blanket claims
Notes: Match the declaration to real behavior

Prompt Template: Generate a privacy policy outline covering collection, use, sharing, retention, security, and user requests.
Output Schema: { overview, data_collected, purpose, sharing, retention, security, user_rights, contact }
Required Inputs: support email, domain, data handling model
Length/Limit: Must be published at a stable URL
Quality Gate: Include deletion request path when supported
Notes: Keep the language clear and direct

Prompt Template: Create a screenshot plan that shows the core value first, then the main workflows, trust signals, and final CTA.
Required Inputs: top feature, target persona, core workflow
Quality Gate: First image must show the core feature
Notes: Avoid outdated phones and clutter

Prompt Template: Define the feature graphic message, visual focus, and safe area for the Play Store feature graphic.
Required Inputs: one core promise, brand colors, icon, logo
Quality Gate: No tiny text; keep the message bold
Notes: Optimize for fast comprehension

Prompt Template: Localize the store listing and keyword set for each target language without changing the product promise.
Quality Gate: Do not translate keywords blindly
Notes: Use native phrasing per market

Prompt Template: Create a final checklist for policy, privacy, screenshots, contact info, and store consistency.
Output Schema: { policy, privacy, contact, screenshots, data_safety, rating, metadata }
Quality Gate: No missing links or broken contact paths
Notes: Treat this as the final gate before submission

Prompt Template: Return the final Google Play workflow result in both Markdown and JSON so it can be pasted into Play Console tooling or a docs pipeline.
Quality Gate: Preserve field names across runs
Notes: Useful for handoff and automation

Prompt Template: I will provide a user review and its rating. Act as a Customer Success Manager and draft a response that addresses the user's specific feedback, offers a solution or gratitude, and maintains a helpful tone.
Quality Gate: No generic 'Thank you' only; must address specific points
Notes: Use placeholders for support links

Prompt Template: Act as a Growth Marketer. Given the current store listing, generate three distinct variations for the Short Description focusing on different emotional triggers like urgency or utility.
Required Inputs: current description, target audience, test objective
Quality Gate: Variants must be significantly different in hook or angle
Notes: Focus on the first 40 characters for mobile visibility

Prompt Template: I will provide a list of technical changes and bug fixes. Rewrite these into user-friendly release notes that highlight benefits while keeping a consistent brand voice.
Required Inputs: technical commits, bug fix log, new features
Quality Gate: Avoid technical jargon; focus on user experience improvements
Notes: Use emojis sparingly to highlight main features

Prompt Template: I will provide the store listing text of three competitors. Analyze their keyword usage and feature highlighting to identify gaps our app can fill.
Length/Limit: No hard limit; infer from context
Quality Gate: Insights must be actionable for metadata updates
Notes: Look for recurring keywords in high-ranking competitor descriptions

Goal: Adapt listing for holidays or events
Prompt Template: Act as a Creative Strategist. Create a seasonal update for the store listing including App Name suffix and Short Description for a specific event.
Required Inputs: target event, current listing, brand guidelines
Quality Gate: Must align with the seasonal theme without losing core USP
Notes: Ensure the update is removed immediately after the event ends

Notes: Focus on the first 40 characters for mobile visibility

Notes: Use emojis sparingly to highlight main features

Required Inputs: target event, current event, brand guidelines
Quality Gate: Must align with the seasonal theme without losing core USP
Notes: Ensure the update is removed immediately after the event ends

Prompt Template: Generate a sequence of 3 push notifications to re-engage users who haven't opened the app in 7 days. Focus on value-add, not just reminders.
Required Inputs: app category, key features, user activity history
Quality Gate: Must include a clear call-to-action (CTA)
Notes: Personalize using [User_Name] placeholders

Prompt Template: Write the copy for a 3-tier subscription model (Basic, Pro, Family). Highlight the incremental value of each tier clearly.
Required Inputs: feature list, pricing points, target revenue model
Quality Gate: Benefits must be logically tiered and non-overlapping
Notes: Focus on the 'Most Popular' tag for the middle tier

Prompt Template: Rewrite standard system error messages (Network Timeout, Invalid Login, Payment Failed) to be helpful, brand-aligned, and less frustrating.
Required Inputs: technical error codes, app tone of voice
Quality Gate: Provide a clear next step for the user to resolve the issue
Notes: Avoid blame-shifting language (e.g., 'You entered wrong')

Prompt Template: Create 5 core FAQ articles based on common user pain points identified in reviews.
Quality Gate: Must be written in a step-by-step 'How-to' format
Notes: Use bold text for UI elements mentioned

Prompt Template: Draft a set of community guidelines for in-app interactions to ensure safety and positive engagement.
Required Inputs: app niche (e.g., social, gaming), target age group
Quality Gate: Must be legally compliant yet readable for a general audience
Notes: Highlight zero-tolerance policies for harassment

Goal: Brief visual designers for app icons
Prompt Template: Generate 3 distinct visual concepts for an app icon that reflect the core USP and category conventions.
Required Inputs: core feature, brand colors, competitor icons
Quality Gate: Must include contrast ratio considerations for dark/light modes
Notes: Focus on a single recognizable central object

Prompt Template: Write a script for a Google Play Store promo video including visual cues, voiceover text, and on-screen text overlays.
Required Inputs: key features, target demographic, music mood
Quality Gate: Must grab attention in the first 3 seconds
Notes: The ending must feature the app icon and a 'Download Now' CTA

Prompt Template: Select and edit the best user testimonials into a 'What Users Are Saying' section for the full description.
Required Inputs: raw user reviews, app store ratings
Quality Gate: Select reviews that address different core features
Notes: Maintain authenticity; use ellipsis for brevity if needed

Prompt Template: Write a personalized email pitch for micro-influencers in the app's niche to request a review or feature.
Required Inputs: influencer name, app USP, collaboration offer
Quality Gate: Must explain why the app is relevant to their specific audience
Notes: Include a clear tracking link for the campaign

Prompt Template: Draft a 3-part welcome email sequence for new users to drive feature adoption and long-term retention.
Required Inputs: app onboarding steps, key value points
Quality Gate: Each email must focus on one specific feature 'win'
Notes: Include an 'Unsubscribe' placeholder for compliance

Prompt Template: Create the copy for an in-app referral program that incentivizes users to invite their contacts.
Quality Gate: The sharing text must sound natural when sent via SMS/WhatsApp
Notes: Clearly state the benefit for both parties

Goal: Generate text for Google App Campaigns
Prompt Template: Write headlines and descriptions for UAC (Universal App Campaigns) that perform well across Search, Play, and YouTube.
Quality Gate: Desc (90)
Notes: Focus on high-intent verbs like 'Track', 'Build', 'Save'

Goal: Align web presence with store listing
Prompt Template: Extract the core messaging from the Play Store listing to create a consistent 1-page website landing page.
Quality Gate: Messaging must be 100% consistent with the app store version
Notes: Ensure the 'Download on Play Store' badge is prominent

Prompt Template: Analyze the last 100 reviews to identify the top 3 'loves' and top 3 'frustrations' among users.
Quality Gate: Actions must be prioritized by frequency of feedback
Notes: Differentiate between UI issues and functional bugs

Prompt Template: Write ad copy for a retargeting campaign targeting users who have uninstalled or haven't opened the app.
Quality Gate: Focus on what has changed or improved since they left
Notes: Use a strong emotional hook regarding the problem solved

Prompt Template: Rewrite the tooltips and modal text for the initial app walkthrough to minimize friction and maximize 'Aha!' moments.
Quality Gate: Keep text concise; the user wants to get into the app
Notes: Focus on the benefit of the step, not just the function

Prompt Template: Take a list of user requests and categorize them by 'Impact vs. Effort' to guide the product roadmap.
Quality Gate: Score on a 1-10 scale based on ASO potential
Notes: Priority should be given to requests that align with keywords

Goal: Draft clear guidance for pre-release users
Prompt Template: Write an email and in-app message for beta testers explaining what to test and how to report bugs.
Required Inputs: new feature list, bug tracking link
Quality Gate: Define 'success' for the beta period clearly
Notes: Remind testers that the app is under development (NDA-safe)

Prompt Template: Provide a checklist for developers to reduce the APK/AAB size to improve install conversion rates in low-bandwidth areas.
Quality Gate: Focus on image compression and unused resource removal
Notes: Mention Google Play Feature Delivery where applicable

Prompt Template: Create a schema for deep links that allow marketing campaigns to drop users directly into specific features.
Quality Gate: URLs must be human-readable and SEO-friendly
Notes: Include fallback to the Play Store if the app isn't installed

Prompt Template: Analyze the store assets (text and screenshots) to ensure they are accessible to users with visual or cognitive impairments.
Quality Gate: Check for color contrast and text clarity in images
Notes: Ensure descriptions are compatible with screen readers

Prompt Template: Create a short promotional update highlighting the launch of 'Dark Mode' to improve user eye comfort.
Quality Gate: Focus on the 'Night Owl' or 'Sleek' aesthetic appeal
Notes: Mention power-saving benefits for OLED screens

Prompt Template: Create a series of discount offers triggered when a user attempts to cancel their subscription.
Quality Gate: Focus on the loss of premium features if they leave
Notes: Use 'One-time offer' phrasing to create urgency

Prompt Template: Draft a sequence of messages (in-app + email) to encourage users to stay after their free trial ends.
Quality Gate: Remind users of the value they've created during the trial
Notes: Provide a clear path to manage or extend the trial

Prompt Template: Design a formal experiment for the Google Play Console to test a new icon vs. the current one.
Required Inputs: current conversion rate, new icon design
Quality Gate: The hypothesis must be testable (e.g., 'Increases CVR by 5%')
Notes: Control group must remain unchanged

Prompt Template: Define the 'Do's and 'Don'ts' of the app's brand voice to ensure all future contributors maintain consistency.
Quality Gate: Include examples of 'On-brand' vs. 'Off-brand' sentences
Notes: Focus on the emotional connection with the user

Prompt Template: Compare the subscription and IAP prices of the top 5 competitors to recommend an optimal price point.
Quality Gate: Identify if the app should be 'Budget', 'Premium', or 'Value'
Notes: Factor in regional pricing differences

Prompt Template: Evaluate the performance of different Play Store categories to see where the app has the highest chance of ranking.
Required Inputs: Play Store category list, app features
Quality Gate: Potential should be based on 'Category Relevancy' vs. 'Competition'
Notes: Suggest a move if the current category is oversaturated

Goal: Find high-volume terms for new markets
Prompt Template: Generate a list of 10 localized keywords for a specific target region (e.g., Brazil, Japan) including translation and intent.
Quality Gate: Do not use literal translations; use local slang or jargon
Notes: Include search volume estimates (High/Med/Low)

Prompt Template: Review the listing for icons, colors, or phrases that might be misunderstood or offensive in a specific culture.
Quality Gate: Focus on color symbolism and local idioms
Notes: Ensure screenshots reflect local diversity

Prompt Template: Create a set of templates for internal team alerts when Play Console metrics (CR, ANR, Crashes) change significantly.
Quality Gate: Include placeholders for specific data points
Notes: Action items must be clear (e.g., 'Roll back' or 'Fix UI')

Prompt Template: Define the acceptable thresholds for crashes and ANRs to ensure the app remains prioritized by the Play Store algorithm.
Quality Gate: Critical thresholds should match Play Store 'Bad Behavior' levels
Notes: Plan must include regular code reviews

Prompt Template: Create 3 detailed user personas based on actual app usage data to better target ASO and ads.
Quality Gate: Personas must feel like real people with specific goals
Notes: Use these personas to test description readability

Prompt Template: Create a table that maps technical features to emotional or functional benefits to improve copy quality.
Quality Gate: Benefits should answer 'What's in it for me?'
Notes: Emotional hooks should drive the Short Description

Prompt Template: Draft a brief for a sound designer to create the audio track for the Play Store promo video.
Quality Gate: Music must be energetic but not overpower the voiceover
Notes: Identify moments where 'Success' or 'Alert' sounds are needed

Goal: Draft text overlays for visual assets
Prompt Template: Write the punchy, benefit-driven captions that will appear on top of the app screenshots.
Quality Gate: Captions must be readable in a 2-second glance
Notes: Ensure text contrast against the screenshot background

Prompt Template: Create 5 different CTA variations for a 'Sign Up' or 'Purchase' button to test which drives more conversions.
Quality Gate: Triggers can include: Scarcity, Logic, Social Proof, Ease
Notes: Limit to 2-3 words per button

Prompt Template: Draft the metadata required to ensure Google Search indexes app content and shows 'Open in App' buttons.
Quality Gate: Titles must be SEO-optimized for mobile search
Notes: Descriptions should encourage app installation

Prompt Template: Create a list of in-app events that should be tracked to measure the success of ASO and ad campaigns.
Quality Gate: Events must correlate with the marketing funnel (e.g., 'Tutorial_Complete')
Notes: Assign a value to high-intent events

Prompt Template: Create a naming convention for marketing campaigns to ensure data is clean and actionable in the dashboard.
Quality Gate: Include version numbers and date tags in the string
Notes: Avoid spaces; use underscores for compatibility

Prompt Template: Map the app's actual data collection practices to the specific categories required by the Google Play Data Safety section.
Quality Gate: Be transparent about third-party SDK data sharing
Notes: Purpose must be selected from Google's predefined list

Prompt Template: Draft the internal reasoning for how to answer sensitive questions regarding violence, social interaction, or user-generated content.
Quality Gate: Answer honestly to avoid app suspension or age-gating errors
Notes: Focus on 'Context' (e.g., 'Cartoon violence' vs. 'Realistic')

Prompt Template: Draft the names and descriptions for individual IAP items (e.g., 'Coin Pack', 'Premium Unlock') in the Play Store dashboard.
Quality Gate: Names should be clear and descriptive of the value
Notes: Descriptions should state exactly what the user receives

Prompt Template: Create the introductory text for an in-app rewards program to increase daily active usage.
Quality Gate: Focus on how 'easy' it is to start earning
Notes: Use gamified language (e.g., 'Level up', 'Unlock')

Prompt Template: Draft a internal policy on how often the app should be updated and what constitutes a 'Major' vs 'Minor' update.
Quality Gate: Maintain a balance between 'Freshness' and 'Update Fatigue'
Notes: Always link updates to visible improvements in the listing

Prompt Template: List the core technologies and libraries used in the app to build trust with privacy-conscious users.
Quality Gate: Explain benefits like 'Encryption' or 'Fast Loading'
Notes: Ensure all third-party libraries comply with Play Store policies

Prompt Template: Generate the text for the 'Open Source Licenses' section of the app, ensuring all third-party credits are included.
Quality Gate: Must follow the specific attribution requirements of each license
Notes: Place in an easily accessible 'About' or 'Settings' menu

Prompt Template: Draft templates for a helpdesk bot to categorize and respond to common support tickets instantly.
Quality Gate: Templates should acknowledge receipt and provide an ETA
Notes: Escalate automatically for 'Billing' or 'Account Access' issues

Goal: Announce a major app launch or update
Prompt Template: Write a formal press release to send to tech journalists and blogs for a major version release.
Required Inputs: app USP, new features, launch date
Quality Gate: Include a 'Boilerplate' section about the company
Notes: Focus on the 'Why now?' angle for journalists

Goal: Define assets for press and partners
Prompt Template: List the required assets (logos, high-res screenshots, founder bios) to be included in a downloadable media kit.
Quality Gate: Include transparent PNGs and vector files for print
Notes: Ensure screenshots are 'Marketing' versions without status bar icons
